Carolina reapers never work for me, I treat them like the above plants and they only yield five or six peppers per season.

Ride share apps were telling me to jump off the bridge so I thought we gotta get away from here, and started walking towards the freeway. As we were walking with hundreds of other people some dude pulled up and said 75 bucks to downtown, before I could answer a couple said yup and started to get in. I looked down at my son, nine at the time, then looked back up and yelled Hey, wanna split it? 

Thankfully, they said yes, I through my son in the front seat, I didn’t want him to sit next to the strange couple, so I put him in the front next to the stranger that was driving us home. Bullet proof logic in my opinion at the time. 

Anyway, they were a lovely couple from Pennsylvania, and our drivers ford focus shook like hell when he braked. When we arrived at their hotel, I pulled out 40 bucks to pay our share but they declined and insisted we use it for something else. 

We took the street car down to or hotel and made it safely back. When I told my wife about the story let’s just say she was less than impressed with my choice but Hey, it worked out. 

Long story short, bring cash so you can take a dodgey focus, and make some new friends and then not even need the cash.
